description: This file defines the CLIInstaller enum responsible for installing, locating, and verifying the 'openclaw' CLI tool. It includes methods for checking installation status, executing installation scripts, parsing installation events, and utility functions for command construction and string escaping.

classes.name: InstallEvent
classes.description: A private struct for decoding JSON events related to the installation process.

methods.name: installedLocation()
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path where the 'openclaw' CLI is installed, if present.

methods.name: installedLocation(searchPaths:fileManager:)
methods.description: Searches through provided paths to find the 'openclaw' executable and returns its path.

methods.name: isInstalled()
methods.description: Checks whether the 'openclaw' CLI is installed by verifying its location.

methods.name: install(statusHandler:)
methods.description: Performs installation of the 'openclaw' CLI, providing status updates via the handler.

methods.name: installPrefix()
methods.description: Determines the installation prefix directory for the CLI.

methods.name: installScriptCommand(version:prefix:)
methods.description: Builds the shell command array to run the installation script with specified version and prefix.

methods.name: parseInstallEvents(_:)
methods.description: Parses the output of the installation script into a list of InstallEvent objects.

methods.name: shellEscape(_:)
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in a shell command.
